hints: Focus on the word photochemical, it tells you sunlight is driving chemical reactions between the starting pollutants.
Remember what a hot car engine makes from air, $\text{N}_2$ and $\text{O}_2$ combine to form nitrogen oxides, and some petrol leaves as unburnt hydrocarbons.
Think which pair reacts together in sunlight to make secondary pollutants like ozone and PAN, that is the classic Los Angeles type smog.
walkthrough:
**Recall what photochemical smog is**

Think of sunny, traffic-filled cities. Sunlight (UV) starts reactions that turn harmless-looking starting gases into ozone, $\text{O}_3$, and other irritants.

These starting gases are called primary pollutants, the smoggy products are secondary pollutants.

**Identify the two key primary pollutants from cars**

In a hot engine, nitrogen and oxygen from air react:
$$\text{N}_2 + \text{O}_2 \rightarrow 2\text{NO}$$
Further oxidation gives $\text{NO}_2$. Together these are $\text{NO}_x$.

At the same time, incomplete combustion releases carbon monoxide and unburnt hydrocarbons (volatile organic compounds).

**Put the sunlight chemistry together**

It is the mixture of nitrogen oxides and unburnt hydrocarbons that absorbs sunlight and reacts to form photochemical smog.

Simplified idea:
$$\text{NO}_x + \text{hydrocarbons} \xrightarrow{\text{UV light}} \text{ozone} + \text{PAN} + \text{other oxidants}$$

options.A: Carbon dioxide and water vapour are the normal, complete combustion products of fuel. They contribute to the greenhouse effect but they do not react in sunlight to make photochemical smog.
options.B: Carbon monoxide and unburnt hydrocarbons are both from vehicles and CO is very toxic, but CO is not the sunlight-driven partner. Without nitrogen oxides you cannot get the ozone-forming photochemical cycle.
options.C: Nitrogen oxides ($\text{NO}$ and $\text{NO}_2$) plus unburnt hydrocarbons are the classic primary pollutants. In UV sunlight they undergo free-radical reactions to produce ozone, peroxyacetyl nitrate (PAN) and other components of photochemical smog.
options.D: Sulfur dioxide and water vapour lead to a different problem, industrial or London-type smog and acid rain ($\text{H}_2\text{SO}_3$ and $\text{H}_2\text{SO}_4$). This needs sulfur-containing fuels, not sunlight-driven car exhaust chemistry.
